name: lyrc
description: Make lyric videos for your songs: fill them with footage, pick a lyric style, fix the words, export an MP4 and post to Instagram.

interface.longDescription:
LYRC makes lyric videos for independent musicians. Ask ChatGPT to make a lyric video for your song, make a music video for a new single, or make Instagram Reels for a release, and LYRC builds them from your songs.

Add a song right in the chat: say its name and artist, paste a Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, YouTube or SoundCloud link, or attach the audio file. LYRC picks a 15-second part, transcribes and times the lyrics, puts cut markers on the beat and saves the song for next time. After that, ChatGPT can:
- make a new video for that song and fill every cut with stock footage (30 moods, from club nights to nature) or your own clips
- show you the storyboard right in the chat
- switch between lyric animation styles, or turn them off and set the font, colors and outline yourself
- fix a misheard word or retime a line
- add color grades and transitions that land on the beat
- swap, zoom or lock individual clips
- pull clips out of a video link
- make up to 30 videos at once for a release, then keep or ditch each one
- export a finished MP4 and post it to Instagram now or schedule it

Exports and Instagram posts only go through after you confirm them in the chat. Finished videos play in the chat with a download link that doesn't expire.

Limits: you need a LYRC account. Add only songs that are yours. Instagram posting needs an Instagram professional account connected in LYRC.
defaultPrompt: Add my song to LYRC and make a lyric video of it.
Make a lyric video for my newest song.
Export my latest lyric video as an MP4.

positive.description: Add the artist's own song by link and get its first video
positive.prompt: This is my song, add it to LYRC and make a lyric video of it: https://www.deezer.com/track/4264811482
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the song ("oh no" by loya), picks a 15-second part, transcribes the lyrics, cuts on the beat and saves the song. Shows progress while it works (20-90 seconds), then gives the new video's free editor link. On this paid account the video's slots start empty, so ChatGPT asks which footage to use and fills them with auto_fill_project. Asking again returns the same song and video instead of a duplicate.

positive.description: Add the artist's own song from an attached audio file
positive.prompt: Here's my new song, make a lyric video from it. (attach an MP3 or M4A of a song with vocals, 30 seconds to 10 minutes long)
positive.expected_behavior: Uploads the attached file to LYRC, picks the loudest 15-second part, transcribes it and saves the song, then makes its first video and shows the storyboard after filling it with the footage the user picks. If the file isn't audio or is shorter than 15 seconds, it says so and adds nothing.

positive.description: Make a lyric video for a song in the account
positive.prompt: Make a lyric video for my song atari with club night footage.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new video for atari, fills every cut with club footage, shows the storyboard card in the chat, and gives the free editor link to preview it.

positive.prompt: Switch the lyrics in that video to the VOLTAGE style.
positive.expected_behavior: Sets VOLTAGE as the active lyric style and confirms it with get_style.

positive.description: Export with a price check first
positive.expected_behavior: The first export_project call spends nothing and reports what the export costs, then ChatGPT asks. After the user says yes, it exports, and wait_for_export plays the finished video in the chat with a lyrc.studio download link.

negative.description: Posting publicly without an agreed caption and time, on an account without Instagram connected. Nothing is posted; ChatGPT reports Instagram isn't connected or asks to confirm the post first.
negative.prompt: Post my newest video to Instagram right now.

negative.description: Bulk deletion. Deletes are two-step and destructive; nothing is deleted without the user confirming each item, and a song with videos refuses to delete unless that is asked for explicitly.
negative.prompt: Delete all my songs and videos.

negative.description: A song that isn't the user's. add_song is only for the artist's own songs, so ChatGPT asks whether the song is theirs (or explains LYRC only adds the artist's own music) and adds nothing until they say it is.
negative.prompt: Add Blinding Lights by The Weeknd to LYRC and make a lyric video of it.

review.commerce_description: LYRC does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Users sign in to their existing LYRC account, and exports use the allowance their LYRC plan already includes.

publication.release_notes: Add your own song in the chat: by name and artist, a Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, YouTube or SoundCloud link, or an attached audio file. LYRC transcribes it, cuts it on the beat and makes its first video, with no trip to the app.
